query:
SELECT lc.contaCustoId, cc.nome, ROUND(SUM(lc.valor), 2) as total
FROM lancamento_custo lc
JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY lc.contaCustoId, cc.nome
ORDER BY total DESC
